title: 第十五章 你们是来打工的第十六章 这是我们的位置
content_zh:
再说教学楼门口，当陆原看着李梦瑶被杜亮抱上了车，心里又是一痛。
难道车就这么吸引女生吗？
难道一辆车就这么容易让女生兴奋吗？
这还只不过是一辆帕萨特而已啊。
梦瑶，你就这么轻贱自己吗？
突然，陆原觉得自己的胳膊被人抓住了，不由自主的被拖着跟那人走了好几步。
然后陆原才看清楚，抓住自己胳膊的人，是张遐。
“陆原，还看什么看，你还对李梦瑶念念不忘是吧？”
刚才发生的那一幕，张遐自然也在人群里。
而陆原呆呆的看着李梦瑶上车离去，张遐也自然尽收眼底。
此时，张遐脸上有点气闷，似乎气闷陆原还一直想着李梦瑶这种贪图虚荣的女人，但是也有点心疼，心疼陆原被伤害的这么深。
“我……”
陆原不知道该说什么，他知道张遐是为自己好，可是，陆原是一个很重感情的人。
尽管李梦瑶是很渣，分手之后，陆原却时时回忆起李梦瑶对自己好的那些画面。
“走吧，去百盛园，今天我一定要请你吃饭！不醉不归！”
张遐觉得，现在只有酒，才可以解决陆原现在的状况了。
为情所困，所以，借酒消愁。
“不，我说过的，我要请你吃饭，走吧，我们去米其林。”
陆原觉得自己真的要请张遐吃顿饭了，不管怎么说，张遐是一个好女孩，也是个好朋友，在自己这样的情况下，还开导自己。
知道自己是穷学生的情况下，依然对自己好的人并不多，张遐算一个。

张遐噗嗤就笑了：“陆原，你是在哄我吗？上次你就用过这一招了，这一次还来啊，能不能换个花样啊？”
米其林？那怎么可能啊。
“走啦。”
陆原知道怎么解释也没用，干脆拉着张遐，到了校外打了个出租车直奔米其林。
一直到下了车，站在米其林的门口，张遐还是不敢相信。
“陆原，别玩了，待会儿要是被人家赶出来，那就不好了。”看着米其林门口的各种豪车，还有里面豪华的装修，张遐心里发怵，更担心陆原只是戏弄她而已。
“走吧，进去吧。”
陆原依然不跟她多解释，拉着张遐进了米其林。
“等一下，我上个洗手间。”
进了米其林，张遐有点紧张，她自然不相信陆原有钱能请她到这里吃饭，所以，虽然已经进来了，张遐却觉得自己和小偷一样。
“嗯，我也正好去洗下手。”
两人来到洗手间，张遐进去了，陆原在外面洗了手烘干之后，就在外面等候。
正在这时候，突然，又一对男女走了过来。
见到陆原，女的一愣：“是你？”
content_en:
Let's talk about the door of the teaching building. When Lu Yuan saw Li Mengyao being carried into the car by Du Liang, he felt a pain in his heart again.
Are girls so attracted to cars?
Is it so easy for a car to excite girls?
This is just a Passat.
Mengyao, do you despise yourself so much?
Suddenly, Lu Yuan felt that his arm was grabbed by someone, and he was involuntarily dragged several steps with the person.
Then Lu Yuan saw clearly that the person grabbing his arm was Zhang Xia.
"Lu Yuan, what are you looking at? You still miss Li Mengyao, right?"
In the scene that just happened, Zhang Xia was naturally among the crowd.
Lu Yuan watched blankly as Li Mengyao got into the car and left, and Zhang Xia naturally had a panoramic view.
At this time, Zhang Xia's face was a little annoyed. It seemed that Lu Yuan was still thinking about vain women like Li Mengyao, but he was also a little distressed, feeling sorry that Lu Yuan was hurt so deeply.
"I..."
Lu Yuan didn't know what to say. He knew that Zhang Xia was doing it for his own good, but Lu Yuan was a very emotional person.
Although Li Mengyao was a scumbag, after the breakup, Lu Yuan always recalled the scenes of Li Mengyao being kind to him.
"Let's go to Parkson Garden. I will definitely treat you to dinner today! You won't come back until you're drunk!"
Zhang Xia felt that only wine could solve Lu Yuan's current situation.
I was trapped by love, so I drank to drown my sorrows.
"No, I said, I want to treat you to dinner, let's go, let's go to Michelin."
Lu Yuan felt that he really wanted to treat Zhang Xia to a meal. In any case, Zhang Xia was a good girl and a good friend. In his own situation, he still enlightened him.
Knowing that he is a poor student, there are not many people who are still nice to him, Zhang Xia is one of them.
Zhang Xia burst into laughter: "Lu Yuan, are you trying to trick me? You used this trick last time, and you're going to do it again this time. Can you do it differently?"
Michelin? How is that possible?
"Let's go."
Lu Yuan knew that it was useless to explain, so he simply took Zhang Xia and took a taxi outside the school and went straight to Michelin.
Until he got off the car and stood at the door of Michelin, Zhang Xia still couldn't believe it.
"Lu Yuan, stop playing. It will be bad if you are kicked out later." Looking at the various luxury cars in front of Michelin and the luxurious decoration inside, Zhang Xia felt frightened and worried that Lu Yuan was just teasing her.
"Let's go in."
Lu Yuan still didn't explain anything to her and dragged Zhang Xia into Michelin.
"Wait a minute, I need to use the bathroom."
After entering Michelin, Zhang Xia was a little nervous. Naturally, she didn't believe that Lu Yuan had the money to invite her to eat here. Therefore, even though she had already entered, Zhang Xia felt like a thief.
"Well, I just want to wash my hands."
The two came to the bathroom, Zhang Xia went in, and Lu Yuan washed and dried his hands outside, then waited outside.
At this moment, suddenly, another man and woman came over.
Seeing Lu Yuan, the woman was stunned: "Is it you?"
